name: OH-11
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Brown with large cash advantage
model.rationale: A D+28 Cleveland-area seat with a well-funded incumbent facing a noncompetitive challenger leaves essentially no path for a Republican upset, even in a favorable environment. I shade the baseline slightly for the R-leaning national environment but stay firmly in Safe D.
model.watch: A major scandal or an unexpectedly strong, well-funded challenger campaign could narrow the margin, though not plausibly the outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Shontel Brown, the Democratic incumbent in this heavily Democratic Cleveland-area district, is running for reelection with a large financial advantage: over $1.1 million raised and roughly the same amount on hand, against a Republican challenger with no reported fundraising. The district's partisan lean of D+28 makes a Republican win extremely unlikely under any plausible scenario.

There are no public polls or expert ratings for this race, so the forecast rests on fundamentals, which point strongly Democratic. Prediction markets price Brown's chances near 98 percent, consistent with the baseline model. The main uncertainty is the size of the margin, not the winner, and even that is constrained by the district's lopsided partisan composition.
